messages:
maria: FYI nodes in ap-south started failing to come up after the 582.10 driver image + kernel 6.4.2 push. Boot loops, `systemd` stuck on nvidia-dkms rebuild. Some VMs never hit cloud-init network ready.
ajay: Can you paste the boot log? guessing DKMS compile error or module signature fail. `journalctl -u systemd-modules-load`?
leo: Seen this: `modprobe: ERROR: could not insert 'nvidia': Exec format error` then `modpost: Unexpected kernel version signature` — happened when CUDA 12.3 + NCCL 2.18 used with our custom kernel config.
infra-oncall: Canary pool compute-ap-south1-gpupool-2 impacted: 23/120 nodes failing probe. Autoscaler marking nodes unhealthy. Rolling deploy halted. :warning:
deploy-bot: deploy/driver-582-ap-south halted by health-checks at 1732504365
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2024-1137 (ap-south driver provisioning). Pager notified.
maria: logs attached: 
```
[  12.345678] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.
[  12.345679] modpost: WARNING: mismatched kernel version signature
[  12.345680] DKMS: ERROR: Cannot find module nvidia in dkms tree
```
ajay: Looks like DKMS didn't find prebuilt module for 6.4.2. Two immediate options: (1) rollback driver to 575 on live nodes, (2) rebuild DKMS in image with proper headers. Rollback command I can run: `apt-get install -y --allow-downgrades nvidia-driver-575`.
leo: Rebuilding on node at scale is slow. Alternative: ship prebuilt `/lib/modules/6.4.2/kernel/drivers/video/nvidia.ko` in the AMI and skip DKMS (`/etc/dkms/framework.conf` tweak). That buys time.
infra-oncall: Network flapping seems tied to `nvidia-ucdn` init race; if we delay nvidia service start it sometimes boots. Quick patch: systemd override to add `After=network-online.target` and `ExecStartPre=/bin/sleep 3` for nvidia-dkms-rebuild.service
maria: Can we triage whether it's pure DKMS kernel header mismatch vs signed-module verification? The logs show 'mismatched kernel version signature' which smells like our kernel build id differs from headers used in DKMS.
ajay: Confirmed: headers package in image is `linux-headers-6.4.2-custom-202403` but running kernel is `6.4.2-rc1` on some hosts due to stale boot image. Need kernel-header sync before driver rollout.
leo: Plan: pause rollout, mark canary pool drained for 2 hours, run job to sync headers and prebuild modules, then resume with 10-node canary. I can own prebuild script.
maria: OK please create k-run job and update runbook. Tagging @infra-oncall to coordinate node drains. :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: Starting drain now. Will post when 0/23 remain in canary. ETA 25m.
ajay: I'll prepare rollback playbook if needed. If rollback chosen, we prefer apt pin to 575 rather than full node reprovision.
maria: Thanks. Keep thread updated. If anyone sees `_sig` or `modsign` errors paste them here.
